actions: depresses and stabilizes the clavicle at the sternoclavicular joint

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Small, deeply-placed muscle beneath the clavicle; cushions the subclavian vessels immediately below it from the bone during clavicle fracture, a clinically relevant protective relationship.
functional_compartments.source: Holzbaur KR, Murray WM, Delp SL (2005) Ann Biomed Eng 33(6):829-840 -- upper-extremity muscle architecture model (fascicle length, pennation, PCSA)
